topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: Rain pounds the city, relentless. Just got word from an old acquaintance – says they ran into my childhood best friend, but the guy doesn’t remember a thing. Figures. People come and go, memories fade like footprints on wet asphalt. Met this acquaintance for a late-night coffee, the kind of place that stays open because some nights, you just can’t face the empty quiet at home. We talked, but not about the good old days. Told him it happens, folks get busy, move on, get lost. Doesn’t mean a thing. Just the way it is.
